title: U.S. House · Maryland's 3rd District
area: Parts of Anne Arundel, Howard, Baltimore and Montgomery counties, including Annapolis and Columbia.

context.text: Incumbent Sarah Elfreth defeated Jennifer Cross, Austin Dyches, Sean Hammond and Robert Morrison in the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary. Bernard Flowers defeated Ray Bly, Felix Seier and John White in the Republican primary.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in Maryland, 2026

priorities.text: Protecting reproductive health care access, saying decisions should be between a patient and their doctor.
Gun violence prevention, citing her record passing Maryland laws on public carry, ghost guns and safe storage.
Environmental protection, particularly restoring the Chesapeake Bay and addressing climate change.

positions.summary: In her 2024 Ballotpedia survey, says healthcare decisions belong between a patient and their doctor, says she voted to expand access to reproductive healthcare, and says she will fight in Congress to make Roe v. Wade the law of the land again.
positions.quote: Sarah knows healthcare decisions are between you and your doctor – not elected officials or judges.

positions.summary: In her 2024 Ballotpedia survey, says she helped pass Maryland laws banning ghost guns and requiring safe storage, and says she will fight in Congress to ban assault weapons and expand background checks.
In her 2024 Ballotpedia survey, says she passed state laws to invest in clean energy jobs and will fight in Congress for climate justice and to speed the transition to clean energy.
Her 2024 campaign website says she will fight to protect the Affordable Care Act and expand coverage to the nearly 30 million Americans without health insurance.
positions.quote: On Capitol Hill, she will fight to protect the Affordable Care Act from right-wing attacks and to expand coverage to the nearly 30 million Americans without health insurance.

record.text: Passed 84 bills into law during five years in the Maryland Senate, on issues including Chesapeake Bay protection, prenatal care expansion and veterans' PTSD care.
Served on the Maryland Senate budget committee overseeing tens of billions of dollars in transportation, environmental and public safety spending.
Serves on the House Natural Resources Committee and House Armed Services Committee for the 2025-2026 term.

candidates.name: Bernard Flowers

priorities.text: National defense, citing his 21 years of active duty and 13 years as a senior civil servant.
Empowering parents and promoting what he calls excellence in education rather than indoctrination.
Immigration reform, middle-class affordability, fiscal reform, term limits and infrastructure renewal.

positions.summary: In his 2022 Ballotpedia survey (for the Maryland 2nd District race, in an answer about whom he looks up to), says war should be declared by Congress.
positions.quote: War should be used only to defend our country and our allies. It should be declared by Congress.

statements.quote: Berney supports strong immigration enforcement and policies that prioritize national safety.

candidates.researchNotes: Campaign website and Ballotpedia surveys (2022 and 2026) read. The war-powers answer is from the 2022 survey; the website statements are written in the third person. No debate or newsroom questionnaire found.

researchNotes: Biography: Bernard Flowers' employers and service details come from his own Ballotpedia survey response; no campaign website was located.
